card.name: Words just before the word gold
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts where the next word is likely to be "gold", in text about gold metal, gold bullion, or gold-based drugs like auranofin.

modes.label: Linking word before gold
modes.description: A small word such as the, with, like or for right before an expected mention of gold.
modes.example: A carat is "a unit for measuring the weight of jewels," while a karat is "the unit for measuring<< the>> purity of gold."

modes.label: Gold-drug names
modes.description: Partway through a gold salt drug name such as sodium aurothiomalate, after the word gold.

modes.label: Gold market text
modes.description: Words in finance or mining text where gold is the expected next word.
modes.example: “Bullish Sentiment” in the Market<< for>> Physical Gold Bullion
